title: A false validity flag persists
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $L$ be a finite list of optional cells, and let $st$ be a validation state whose first validity flag is false. After applying the option-valued cell update successively to every entry of $L$, that flag remains false.
